edges.mechanism: Fisetin and its metabolite geraldol selectively, reversibly and non-competitively inhibit CYP2C8 in human liver microsomes (Ki 4.1 uM and 11.5 uM).
edges.evidence: In vitro HLM only; no human interaction study

edges.mechanism: Fisetin competitively inhibits CYP2C9-mediated diclofenac 4'-hydroxylation (Ki <=2.2 uM).
edges.evidence: Recombinant enzyme study; clinical relevance unknown

edges.mechanism: CYP2C9 inhibition (main clearance of S-warfarin) plus antiplatelet/antithrombotic activity of fisetin could raise bleeding risk; monitor INR.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic in vitro and rat data; no clinical case or interaction study

edges.mechanism: Fisetin inhibits arachidonic-acid/collagen/ADP-induced platelet aggregation via thromboxane synthesis inhibition and TP receptor antagonism; oral fisetin protected rats from arterial thrombosis. Additive bleeding plausible.
edges.evidence: In vitro rabbit platelets and rat thrombosis model; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Fisetin was co-administered with rt-PA in acute ischemic stroke with lower NIHSS in delayed-treatment strata; bleeding outcomes not reported in abstract despite antiplatelet activity.
edges.evidence: One double-blind RCT (China); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Preclinical synergy with paclitaxel and cabazitaxel; CYP2C8 inhibition could increase paclitaxel exposure. Direction of net clinical effect unknown.
edges.evidence: Cell and xenograft studies plus HLM inhibition; no human data

edges.mechanism: Synergistic lymphoma cell killing with doxorubicin in vitro and in mice; fisetin attenuated doxorubicin-induced vascular senescence in mice.
edges.evidence: Preclinical only

edges.mechanism: Fisetin sensitized renal carcinoma cells to cisplatin (CDK6/PI3K/Akt/mTOR) and reduced cisplatin peripheral neuropathy in rats.
edges.evidence: Preclinical only

edges.mechanism: 100 mg/day fisetin was given alongside chemotherapy in a small CRC RCT (IL-8 reduced); additive pro-apoptotic effects in capecitabine-resistant cells.
edges.evidence: 1 small RCT (n=37) without detailed safety reporting plus cell data

edges.mechanism: Fisetin completely inhibited OAT1-mediated para-aminohippurate uptake at 50 uM and is itself an OAT1 substrate; renal clearance of OAT1 substrates could be altered.
edges.evidence: In vitro transporter study

edges.mechanism: Fisetin is a weak P-gp inhibitor in KB-C2 cells, did not reverse P-gp-mediated daunomycin resistance in MCF-7/ADR cells, and its own biliary excretion is P-gp mediated.
edges.evidence: In vitro and rat data; low relevance expected

edges.mechanism: Fasting glucose, insulin and HOMA-IR decreased with 200 mg/day fisetin in obese men; additive glucose lowering possible.
edges.evidence: 1 small RCT; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Related senolytic flavonol with overlapping CYP2C9 inhibition and antiplatelet activity; own high-dose safety and drug-interaction concerns. Combination not studied.
edges.evidence: In vitro data and safety review; no combination study

edges.mechanism: n-3 fatty acids affect haemostasis without increasing clinically significant bleeding; stacking with fisetin's antiplatelet activity is untested.
edges.evidence: Review of n-3 bleeding data plus preclinical fisetin data

edges.mechanism: Garlic is flagged in perioperative antithrombotic management; combined antiplatelet load with fisetin is theoretical.
edges.evidence: Clinical review plus preclinical fisetin data

edges.mechanism: Ginger is flagged in perioperative antithrombotic management; combined antiplatelet load with fisetin is theoretical.
edges.evidence: Clinical review plus preclinical fisetin data

edges.mechanism: Preclinical chemosensitization and CYP2C8 inhibition make net effect on efficacy/toxicity unpredictable; use only within trials.
edges.evidence: Reviews of preclinical data; one small human RCT

edges.mechanism: Antiplatelet and antithrombotic activity of fisetin in vitro and in rats.
edges.evidence: Preclinical; no human bleeding data

edges.mechanism: No human safety data; long-term safety and PK not established.
edges.evidence: Absence of data (review)

edges.mechanism: Not an assay artifact: possible true INR rise via CYP2C9 inhibition and antiplatelet effect.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic inference
